description: Evaluation of document parsing and key-information extraction on real scanned financial evidence

datasets.citation: Park et al., NeurIPS 2019 Document Intelligence Workshop

tasks.error_analysis: Failures primarily due to ambiguous currency symbols and discount line items
Occasional ambiguity in DD/MM vs MM/DD numeric formats without explicit month names
Complex multi-tiered tax calculations require sub-table bounding logic
Distortions from folded receipts and thermal paper fading
Faded printed stamps and low contrast scans
Digit substitution (0 vs O, 1 vs l) guarded by SMT integer check
Complex nested tables and multi-column invoices

governance_rule: Per Directive Section 50: Document robustness metrics are maintained strictly separate from chargeback precision/recall to prevent confounding document OCR capability with financial risk gating.
